title: Paystride Save Fees, Card Requirement and FDIC Insurance Disclosure
content:
**Monthly fee.** No Paystride Save tier charges a monthly account fee.

**Card requirement.** On every tier, an active Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account is required to open and to fund the Paystride Save account.

**Deposit insurance.** On every tier, deposits are FDIC-insured through Harborline Bank, N.A. on a pass-through basis, up to the standard FDIC insurance amount of $250000.00 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category.

| Tier | Monthly account fee | Active Paystride Visa Payroll Card required to open and fund | FDIC-insured through Harborline Bank, N.A. on a pass-through basis | Standard FDIC insurance amount (per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Save Starter | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | $250000.00 |
| Paystride Save Builder | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | $250000.00 |
| Paystride Save Boost | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | $250000.00 |
| Paystride Save Growth | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | $250000.00 |
| Paystride Save Premier | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | $250000.00 |
| Paystride Save Elite | $0.00 | Yes | Yes | $250000.00 |

The $250000.00 figure is the standard FDIC insurance amount, stated per depositor, per insured bank and per ownership category; it is the same whatever the Paystride Save tier.
